sections.title: Introduction to Video, Sound, and Projection
sections.description: This course builds a technical foundation and language for video, sound, and projection in for theatre, dance, and performance. Topics will include: video on stage using live cameras, prerecorded video, displays and projection techniques, cueing software, programming live sound, sound design, interfaces, and pre-production strategies. These topics will be explored individually and in tandem with one another through studio workshops. Students will apply their knowledge through practical projects supporting the Theatre Arts program's performance festival and productions. This class requires lab/studio hours in addition to the scheduled class time. No previous knowledge necessary.
